note: A checklist meant to be copied into a post and argued with. Each line points at a record, so ticking it is also a tour. Scored in the reader's browser.
title: Never Have I Ever: Wings
lede: Tick what you've done. Copy it. Tag somebody who needs to answer for theirs.

bands.say: You've got a place, and you've got an order.
You've argued about this in a parking lot.
Somebody has your picture on a wall.

tags: Tag the friend who orders ranch.
Tag whoever always takes the last drum.
Tag the one who says they can handle it.
Tag the person who eats the celery.
Tag the friend who orders boneless and means it.

items.t: Eaten wings standing over the sink.
Ordered wings somewhere that mostly sells pizza.
Eaten the celery. Actually eaten it.
Bought the frozen party pack and called it dinner.
Had wings for breakfast.
Licked sauce off my fingers in a public place.
Ordered boneless and called them wings anyway.
Asked for ranch in Buffalo.
Eaten wings with a fork, in front of people.
Paid extra for all flats.
Taken the drums because nobody else would.
Sent an order back for not being crispy enough.
Argued about whether the tip is worth eating.
Eaten the tip.
Said dry when I meant wet.
Put Old Bay on something that was never a crab.
Ordered mumbo sauce and knew what was coming.
Had a wing plate with fried rice in the same bag.
Turned up somewhere that only takes cash.
Driven more than an hour for a specific order.
Eaten a breaded wing and liked it.
Defended bleu cheese to somebody holding ranch.
Told somebody their city does wings wrong.
Stood in the room where they say it started.
Been to Duff's and mentioned it at the Anchor Bar.
Ordered hot and then quietly ordered milk.
Cried at the table and kept going.
Signed a waiver to eat a chicken wing.
Finished a challenge and ended up on the wall.
Made the sauce myself, from scratch.
